title: Couch Clash
description: Couch Clash: fast living-room mini-games played with your hands on camera against the TV. Launch when the viewer wants to play rock paper scissors against the TV, wants a quick reaction or party game to play from the couch, or asks for Couch Clash.
guide: The viewer plays with their hands on camera, not by telling you their move. Never choose or announce a throw for them, and never predict the TV's throw. Call start_round when they say start, go, again, or rematch. Call back_to_menu when they want a different game. After a round you may react to the round_result event in one short line; keep quiet during a round so you don't talk over the countdown.

game.description: Open straight into this game. Use "rps" when the viewer asks for rock paper scissors. Omit to show the game menu.

capabilities.name: media.camera
capabilities.reason: Couch Clash reads your hand gestures to play. Video is processed on this TV and is never uploaded.

tools.name: open_game
tools.description: Open one of the Couch Clash games. Use when the viewer names a game to play ("play rock paper scissors") or picks one from the menu.

game.description: Which game. "rps" is rock paper scissors, the only game available so far.

tools.name: start_round
tools.description: Start the next round of the open game (the countdown begins immediately). Use when the viewer says start, go, ready, again, or rematch.

tools.name: back_to_menu
tools.description: Leave the current game and return to the Couch Clash game menu. Use when the viewer wants to stop this game or pick a different one.
